class.name: GameplayDebuggerCategory
class.brief_description: One section of the gameplay debugger.
class.description:
Split in two, because the interesting state lives on the server: - [method _collect_data] runs on the [b]server[/b] for the node the viewer is looking at. Return plain data - it is sent over the network. - [method _draw_data] runs on the viewer's machine when data arrives and returns BBCode for the overlay. [param target] is the local copy of the node, so comparing it with the server's data is how prediction and replication problems show up. - [method _draw_world] runs on the viewer's machine every frame; draw with [DebugDraw]. Register an instance with [method GameplayDebugger.register_category], or list the script in [code]application/game_framework/debug/gameplay_debugger_categories[/code] (set [member category_name] in [code]_init[/code]). [codeblock] extends GameplayDebuggerCategory
func _init() -> void: category_name = "Tree"
func _collect_data(target: Node, _viewer: Node) -> Dictionary: return {"hp": target.hp} if target is ChoppableTree else {}
func _draw_data(_target: Node, data: Dictionary) -> String: return "hp %d" % data.hp if data else "not a tree" [/codeblock]

method.name: _collect_data
method.description: Server: the data to show for [param target] ([code]null[/code] when nothing is targeted). [param viewer] is the requesting [PlayerController].

method.name: _draw_data
method.description: Viewer's machine: BBCode for the overlay, from the server's [param data].

method.name: _draw_world
method.description: Viewer's machine, every frame: world shapes with [DebugDraw].

method.name: find_component
method.description: The first node of [param class_name] at or under [param target] - or anywhere in the pawn when [param target] is a [Pawn].

members.member: The name shown in the overlay and used by [code]gd.category[/code].
